title: datawhalechina/self-llm: practical guides for running and tuning open models
friendlyTitle: self-llm teaches people how to run and tune open AI models
summary: self-llm is an Apache-licensed collection of Linux tutorials for deploying, using and fine-tuning open language and multimodal models. The mostly Chinese-language project includes an English guide and has about 32,000 GitHub stars.
friendlySummary: This project offers step-by-step Linux guides for setting up, using and fine-tuning many open models. Most content is in Chinese, with an English guide also available.
whyItMatters: Learners and practitioners can follow model-specific setup paths for local deployment and LoRA or full-parameter tuning across different hardware. Check each model’s current requirements and licence before committing expensive compute.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a practical learning path for local models. Check hardware needs and model licences before starting a large training job.
